name: Electrodynamics
description: Electrostatics: electric field, scalar potential, multipole expansion, introduction to gradient and fundamental theorem of gradients, introduction to divergence and Gauss’s law, fundamental theorem of divergence, fundamental theorem of curl, introduction to Dirac delta function, method of images, energy stored in an electrostatic configuration, capacitors, electric fields in matter. Special theory of relativity: Michelson-Morley’s experiment, four vectors, Lorentz transformations, length contraction and time dilation, transformation of electromagnetic fields. Magnetostatics: biot-Savarts law, Lorentz force, vector potential, energy stored in a magnetic field, magnetic field in matter. Boundary value problems, Green’s function method. Electrodynamics: electromagnetic induction, Maxwell’s equations, Poynting’s vector, Poynting’s theorem, EM waves, reflection, refraction and absorption of EM waves.
